population.title: Israelis of Ethiopian origin, by place of birth
population.question: People born in Ethiopia, and people born in Israel whose father was born in Ethiopia.
population.note: The CBS definition leaves out the third generation and the children of Ethiopian-born mothers only, so it undercounts the community as people experience it. The CBS total for the end of 2024 is 177,600 (reported by JNS, November 2025).

stations-2019.title: How these polling stations voted: Ethiopian-Israeli neighborhoods, April and September 2019
stations-2019.question: Share of the vote at polling stations in neighborhoods with large Ethiopian-Israeli populations.
stations-2019.note: These stations serve mixed neighborhoods; the results are not the Ethiopian-Israeli vote. Blue and White ran under that name in both elections.

kiryat-malachi.title: How these towns voted: Kiryat Malachi, 2019–2020
kiryat-malachi.question: Each list's share of valid votes cast at Kiryat Malachi's ballot boxes.
kiryat-malachi.note: A whole-town result: about 14% of Kiryat Malachi's residents are of Ethiopian origin (CBS, end 2023). Lists are shown as they ran that year: the Union of Right-Wing Parties (URWP) in April 2019, Yamina in September 2019 and March 2020. Likud's national share in the same files: 26.5%, 25.1% and 29.5%. Double-envelope votes are not included.
